contract.steps: Increment once per nonterminal player collision and reset after the fourth contact.
contract.threshold_action: Advance INTERACTION_COUNTER_DIGITS through InteractionCounter_AdvancePrimaryDigits and optionally queue the associated audio command.
contract.tail: Reinitialize the collided actor through the shared collision-template path.

conclusion: The byte represents the type-0x42 collision cadence that gates primary interaction-counter advancement.
